messages:
Maya (Product): @sam quick heads-up — AcmePay is asking for an Optimize pilot that includes per-route batching recommendations, cache TTL hints, quantization recommendations by model family, and eval-triggered alerts tied to their test-suite. They want a pilot in ~6 weeks.
Sam (Eng): That's a lot. Can we phase? I think batching + eval alerts cover most of their cost/quality pain. Quantization could be phase 2.
Elena (Eng-ML): Per-route quant recs need offline evals + perf/accuracy tradeoff matrix. Collecting that and validating is non-trivial — estimate 3–4w just to gather reliable metrics.
Jordan (Customer Success): AcmePay's priority is cost reduction and predictable regressions. They'll accept a phased approach. They want a clear safety rollback and a pilot SLA on alert FP rate.
Arjun (Platform): From infra side, batching hints are mostly telemetry + a small recommendation API. We need consistent per-route tags and a schema change to surface runtime stats. Live recs vs offline: tradeoffs on complexity.
Chris (QA): Eval-triggered alerts are useful but we'll need golden prompt sets, mutation testing to estimate FP, and a mute/ack flow in Console. Also need a way to simulate alerts in staging.
Maya (Product): Proposal for pilot scope (to keep timeline realistic): 1) per-route batching recommendations (auto + manual override), 2) cache TTL suggestions surfaced in Console, 3) threshold-based eval alerts hooked to customer prompt sets. No quant recommendations in pilot. Launch gates: a) latency regression <5% p95, b) alert FP <10% on pilot corpora, c) docs + SDK examples, d) customer sign-off.
Elena (Eng-ML): Agree on pilot. We'll add a nightly eval runner that computes a model quality score and the alert triggers. That buys us a simple quality signal without full quant tooling.
Sam (Eng): Rough eng estimate: batching + cache recs + alert plumbing = 6–8 weeks for a 3-engineer squad + 1 ML engineer. If we reallocate a couple folks from infra, we can aim for 5 weeks. Need product to finalize scope now.
Jordan (Customer Success): AcmePay will join pilot if we provide feature-flag gating, per-route control, and a short MOU. They don't require on-prem for this pilot.
Arjun (Platform): Two infra notes: 1) add per-route telemetry tags (tiny schema change), 2) recommendation API should be idempotent and cacheable. I'll open infra tickets and mark them high priority if approved.
Maya (Product): Action items: - @Sam: triage engineering EPIC and break into milestones - @Elena: define pilot eval prompt set and nightly runner - @Arjun: infra tickets for telemetry + rec API - @Jordan: draft pilot MOU and onboarding checklist - @Chris: QA test plan incl. load tests for batching. Planning sync scheduled Thu 10:30.
deploy-bot: Meeting created: "Optimize pilot: batching/cache/alerts" — Thu 10:30 — room: conf-prod-3
Chris (QA): Adding example test config to thread so devs have a reference: ```yaml
route: acmepay/charge
batching:
  enabled: true
  max_batch_size: 64
  prefer_latency_ms: 50
cache:
  ttl_suggestion_seconds: 3600
alerts:
  eval_threshold_delta: 0.05 # trigger if quality drops by 5% vs baseline
  mute_window_minutes: 60
```
Sam (Eng): I'll post a proposed milestone timeline and resource plan by EOD Mon. Also want to confirm ownership of the rec UI components.
Maya (Product): Thanks all — I'll update the roadmap card and include the launch gates + risk notes. :thumbsup:
